## Invitations

The outreach record shows that 6970 people were invited. Of those invited, 3254 attended, giving an attendance rate of 46.7. This indicates that almost half of the people contacted took part in the activity. The figures provide a straightforward summary of invitation and attendance levels for the reporting period. They should be read together when reviewing the reach of the outreach work and the level of participation achieved.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 5868 invitees. No reminders were issued, with the recorded reminder total being 0. Van days were maintained where road conditions allowed, supporting continued access to outreach activity. These arrangements provided the available contact and attendance opportunities during the period covered by the report. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
